en.topic_title: Authorities euthanised over 700 wild boars last year as population halves since catch-and-kill policy reinstated
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong authorities euthanised over 700 wild boars last year, with the population halving since the government reinstated a capture-and-kill programme in late 2021, official figures have shown.



A wild boar in Hong Kong. Photo: Kelly Ho/HKFP.
